Act5-3#1.zh: 来嘛！只不过上五岳楼喝个小茶，聊个小天嘛。何必这么扭扭捏捏呢？
Act5-3#1.t: Come on! Just a little tea up at the Five Peaks Tower, a little chat. Why so coy?

Act5-3#2.zh: 人...人家可是有丈夫的人，怎么可以跟着陌生男子随便上酒楼...
Act5-3#2.t: I... I'm a married woman. How could I go up to a tavern with a strange man...

Act5-3#3.zh: 我们家主人可是当朝高太尉之子，名满天下的美男子；世上不知道有多少女子迷恋他？这种天下知名的风流人物怎么会是『陌生男子』啊？
Act5-3#3.t: Our master is the son of Marshal Gao himself, the most handsome man in the land. Who knows how many women swoon over him? How could so famous a gallant be a 'strange man'?

Act5-3#4.zh: 是啊是啊，我们高衙内的风度翩翩，能够与他春宵一夜，也算是三生有幸啊。
Act5-3#4.t: That's right! Our Young Master Gao is so dashing; a single night with him would be the luck of three lifetimes.

Act5-3#5.zh: 唉...你那个丈夫那里比得上本人的风流倜傥？小美人，『有花堪折直须折，莫待无花空折枝。』如此风花雪月的良辰美景，正是谈情说爱的好时机啊！
Act5-3#5.t: Sigh... how could that husband of yours compare to my charm? My little beauty, 'pluck the flower while it blooms, lest you pluck at empty branches.' Such a fine, romantic day is perfect for love!

Act5-3#6.zh: 啊！真不愧是少爷啊！文思泉涌，出口成章；令小人佩服的五体投地！
Act5-3#6.t: Ah! Truly worthy of our young master! Such eloquence, poetry at every breath! I bow down in admiration!

Act5-3#7.zh: 少爷的天纵英明，我们凡人哪里比得上他的千分...不，是万分之一啊！
Act5-3#7.t: The young master's genius is heaven-sent. We mortals can't match a thousandth... no, a ten-thousandth of him!

Act5-3#10.zh: 你叫啊？全东京城上下有谁不知道我是高太尉的儿子；是没有人敢跟我作对！谁敢当见义勇为的英雄好汉，那就是找死！
Act5-3#10.t: Scream, then! Everyone in Kaifeng knows I'm Marshal Gao's son; no one dares cross me! Anyone who plays the hero is asking to die!

Act5-3#11.zh: 调戏良人妻子，当得何罪！
Act5-3#11.t: What is the penalty for molesting a decent man's wife!

Act5-3#12.zh: (不好！这位是高太尉的干儿子，人称『花花太岁』的高衙内...)
Act5-3#12.t: (Oh no! It's Marshal Gao's adopted son, Young Master Gao, the 'Playboy Lord'...)

Act5-3#13.zh: 唷，这不是林冲吗？本人正在谈情说爱的时候，你干什么来搅局？想来英雄救美？还是活得不耐烦了？还不赶快退下！
Act5-3#13.t: Oh, if it isn't Lin Chong. I'm in the middle of courting; why are you butting in? Here to rescue the beauty? Or tired of living? Get out of here!

Act5-3#14.zh: ...衙内有所不知，此名女子乃小人的妻子；希望衙内就此罢手。
Act5-3#14.t: ...You may not know, young master, but this woman is my wife. I hope you'll leave it at that.

Act5-3#15.zh: 哦，这年头英雄救美是用半路上认老婆的方法啊？无凭无据，为什么我要相信你？这种话我也会说，这个女子是我指腹为婚的妻子；怎样？
Act5-3#15.t: Oh, so these days heroes rescue beauties by claiming them as wives on the spot? No proof, so why should I believe you? I can say that too: this woman was promised to me before she was born. How's that?

Act5-3#16.zh: (衙内有所不知，这名女子的确是林冲的妻子。)
Act5-3#16.t: (Young master, this woman really is Lin Chong's wife.)

Act5-3#17.zh: 就算是你的妻子又怎么样？被我高衙内看上眼的女子，我还不曾没弄上手过！你不过是个小小的教头，还敢顶撞我？
Act5-3#17.t: So what if she's your wife? No woman I, Young Master Gao, have set my eyes on has ever gotten away! You're just a lowly instructor, and you dare talk back to me?

Act5-3#19.zh: 怎样，敢打我吗？来呀，我的脸颊就在这里给你打。
Act5-3#19.t: Well? Dare to hit me? Go on, my cheek's right here for you.

Act5-3#22.zh: 老虎不发威，你把我当病猫！
Act5-3#22.t: When the tiger doesn't roar, you take it for a sick cat!

Act5-3#23.zh: 啊...血 、流血了！牙齿也掉了；还有我俊美的脸...杀！给我把林冲杀掉！
Act5-3#23.t: Ah... blood, I'm bleeding! My teeth are knocked out! And my handsome face... Kill! Kill Lin Chong for me!

Act5-3#24.zh: 忍无可忍，毋须再忍，该出手的时候到了！
Act5-3#24.t: Enough is enough. The time to strike has come!
